Great North Road (T2), Mkushi, Central Province

General arrangement, grids, openings & room data
Re-planned: 101 bays on 1.80 ha; full set
External wall: 190 mm hollow concrete block (7 MPa) to SANS 1215, 15 mm cement plaster both sides, 2 coats acrylic PVA. 230 mm overall. Brickforce every 3rd course.
Internal wall: 140 mm concrete block, 15 mm plaster both sides; full-height tiling to wet areas. 170 mm overall. Built to underside of ceiling, top course sealed.
Shower partition: 90 mm block, 10 mm render, ceramic tiled both sides; 2 100 mm high, bull-nosed tile capping.
WC cubicle system: 13 mm compact HPL panels on 316 stainless legs, 150 mm floor clearance, 2 000 mm high, indicator bolts.
1. Load-bearing masonry on strip footings; RC ring beam 230 × 230 at wall plate (+3.300). Structural engineer to confirm.
2. Verandah: 100 × 100 × 3 SHS posts on 600 × 600 × 600 C25 pad footings at grid 1–11 / D; lean-to roof at 5°.
3. All ablution floors: non-slip porcelain (R11) laid to 1:80 falls to 110 mm floor gullies / stainless channel.
4. Entrances to ablutions are door-less baffled openings (privacy screens) for hygiene and passive ventilation.
5. Accessible WC/shower to SANS 10400-S: 1 000 mm leaf outward-opening, 1 500 mm turning circle, grab rails.
6. High-level windows W-04/05/06/07 (cill +2 100) plus mechanical extract to all ablutions (10 ac/h).
7. Ramp 1:12 at west end of verandah; verandah level with FFL; 150 mm kerb drop to footway.
8. Kiosk is an operator-run tenancy (hot drinks / prepared food); no on-site cooking beyond 2-plate unit.
Ratios follow BS 6465-1 workplace provision adjusted for a 95 % male, overnight user profile; confirm with operator brief.
